Class UserDetailDTO

java.lang.Object
com.qm.bupt.dto.UserDetailDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class UserDetailDTO extends Object implements Serializable
DTO for the admin user detail view, providing role-specific deep information.

Contains common user fields plus role-specific data:

  • TA: full TA profile + application history
  • MO: full MO profile + published job list
  • Admin: basic info only
